H1.criterion: Every proof record has a declared protocol.N scale and the total proof count equals sum(protocol.N); per scale s in protocol.N: exactly N[s] proof records exist, each with non-empty digests {records,gold,manifest} + goldMetrics carrying the full expected key set (finite numbers), and all records share identical canonicalJson({digests, goldMetrics}).

H2.criterion: The set of {class|handling} verdicts exactly equals the protocol.tamperMatrix identity set (no missing, no unexpected, no duplicate); EACH verdict's rederivedDisposition equals the disposition its {class|handling} identity is assigned by protocol.tamperMatrix (identity->disposition binding); every tamper verdict conforms to its rederivedDisposition rule (fail-closed => verifyStatus in {fail,crash} & fingerprintMatch; accepted/acknowledged-limitation => pass & fingerprintMatch; dropped => pass), every dispositionMatch===true, and the per-disposition counts equal the protocol.tamperMatrix bucket lengths.

H3.criterion: resume-reconciliation carries the substantive structure (killA/killB/killC each with casualtyId+postResume+recordedBeforeKill, protocolReplaySmallCount===protocol.N.small, hypothesis===H3) AND reports dupTotal===0, gapTotal===0, finalMultisetMatch===true.

H4.criterion: Every proof record elapsedMs is a finite, non-negative number <= protocol.budgetCaps.msPerVerify.

claim: Under the recorded environment (pinned node version, platform, and instrument commit), the memory-baseline evidence instrument is replay-deterministic (identical digests over N independent replays at 1k and 1M scale), tamper-evident for the enumerated tamper matrix (every class in the fail-closed set fails closed with its pre-registered fingerprint, including classes that leave surface scores perfect), and campaign-operable (an unattended batch completed with every iteration ending in a machine-checkable proof record or an explicit stop record, surviving the probed interruption classes — process kill at an iteration boundary and mid-iteration — without duplication or gaps).
